title: The first yellow leaf
logline: The maple by the tavern's back door with one yellow leaf among the green, September 7. The pair to November's last. The pup not looking up this time.

panels.composition: A green maple beside a tavern's back door with a single yellow leaf among the green, a small three-legged dog walking past beneath it not looking up.
